text_blocks.snippet: Several notable artists died from AIDS-related complications. Keith Haring, a prominent pop artist known for his graffiti-inspired style, passed away in 1990 due to AIDS. Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, also succumbed to AIDS-related bronchial pneumonia in 1991. Other artists who died from AIDS include Rudolf Nureyev, a celebrated ballet dancer, and Anthony Perkins, known for his role in Psycho.
Here's a more detailed look at some of these artists:
